people.name: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
people.field: history of ancient religion, especially ancient Greek religion and early Christianity

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.role: professor of Religious Studies and Theology
relations.evidence: He served as a professor of Religious Studies and Theology at the University of Groningen.

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: His father Rolf Hendrik Bremmer was a Calvinist minister and a church historian

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: His maternal great-grandfather Lucas Lindeboom (1845–1933) was a professor at the Kampen Theological College.

relations.subject: Lucas Lindeboom
relations.evidence: His maternal great-grandfather Lucas Lindeboom (1845–1933) was a professor at the Kampen Theological College.

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: Bremmer studied Classics and Spanish at the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (1962–1970)

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: Subsequently he taught ancient history at the University of Utrecht, as an Assistant Professor (1974–1978)

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: In 1979, he obtained a Ph.D. from the Vrije Universiteit with a dissertation on The Early Greek Conception of the Soul

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: In 1990, Bremmer joined the University of Groningen as the Chair of Religious Studies, in Faculty of Theology and Religious Studies.

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: He served as the dean of the Faculty during 1996–2005.

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: He was the inaugural Getty Villa Professor at Malibu during 2006–2007.

relations.subject: Jan Nicolaas Bremmer
relations.evidence: He served as a visiting professor at several other places, including the University of Edinburgh (2007).
